text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, and clean, detail-focused spreadsheet work.

I’d be a great fit for your Shopify listing project. I’ve built Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home using Shopify, Google Sheets, and Looker Studio, turning order exports into RFM-based segments that fed their email tool. That work helped identify a top segment representing 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, with email revenue up 19%.

For your store, I can help organize SKU, pricing, and item data, source missing product details from supplier sites, and keep listings accurate and consistent. I’m also comfortable with basic image cleanup and formatting so photos are square and ready for product pages.

I’m easy to communicate with, detail-oriented, and ready to support your growing product catalog.
